title: Insulcon Group | Netherlands Aerogel Blanket Distributor
content:
The Insulcon Group is a leading European distributor and converter of high-temperature insulation solutions, headquartered in Steenbergen, the Netherlands. Founded in 1980 and part of the IPCOM Group since 2015, Insulcon supplies a comprehensive range of thermal insulation products and engineered systems to industrial customers across Europe and worldwide.

Insulcon is an authorized distributor of Aspen Aerogels products, offering the full range of Pyrogel® and Cryogel® aerogel insulation blankets. These include Pyrogel® XTE for corrosion-under-insulation protection in medium-to-high temperature service, Pyrogel® XTF combining thermal insulation with passive fire protection, Pyrogel® HPS optimized for high-temperature hydrocarbon and chemical processing, and Cryogel® Z for cryogenic and sub-ambient applications down to −200 °C. Insulcon provides tailored, CNC-waterjet-cut aerogel insulation sections for pipes, elbows, valves, vessels, and other equipment.

  • Coverage Area: Europe-wide distribution with offices and facilities in the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, United Kingdom, Switzerland, Italy, Hungary, and France; global network of dedicated agents
  • Focus Areas: High-temperature insulation, cryogenic insulation, passive fire protection, aerogel blanket distribution and conversion, petrochemical and LNG insulation, power generation insulation, marine and offshore insulation
  • Current Brands Represented: Aspen Aerogels (Pyrogel®, Cryogel®), Insulcon proprietary Calcon calcium silicate, Insulboard MPU microporous products, and additional refractory and fibre-based insulation brands
  • Official Website: www.insulcon.com

The company’s official website confirms distribution and conversion of aerogel insulation blankets across petrochemical, LNG, power generation, offshore, and industrial markets. Insulcon operates state-of-the-art CNC waterjet cutting facilities and an in-house engineering department to deliver project-specific aerogel insulation solutions, including pre-formed sections for piping and equipment, with cladding supplied as an integrated one-stop-shop offering.
